title: Canonical 本地运行时幂等启动与真实健康诊断
user_outcome: 同一 canonical runtime 重复执行启动不会重复拉起服务、误杀未知进程或漂移端口，并能看到真实 API/代理/语音/worker 状态
current_facts: 共享演示端口固定为 API 4000、frontend 4175、speech 8100
attempt 2 的命令行包含判断可被 PowerShell sleep 伪造，且运行态不能证明 exact candidate commit
attempt 3 使用 nonce/PID/可执行文件/启动时间/根目录/commit/角色精确 argv/lock 的联合证明，复用只接受 exact candidate
attempt 5 review round 2 将 wrapper 与 child 的 Windows 实时完整 argv 纳入联合证明，记录内伪造的 argv 哈希不能替代真实进程参数
attempt 7 在候选 e2350f3cc336c212778232ed2753930e0e1b213d 重新执行隔离套件，clean exact-candidate、连续复用、foreign partial occupancy、PowerShell/same-executable argv spoof 和 wrong commit 全部按契约通过
attempt 8 在候选 9bb02084b6d662e44e29cd5ff8c81504a1fa52c3 再次通过语法与隔离运行时套件，证明 handoff 更新后的 exact candidate 仍满足全部正向和负向契约
attempt 9 在候选 956839d32450e371d666817bf30f801c89d36c28 再次通过语法与隔离运行时套件，证明最新 handoff 候选仍满足全部正向和负向契约

attempt 10 review round 3 的失败直接来自 frontend/login/app.js 中 API/network 失败后的 demo authentication fallback；该路径不在本租约 write_set/allowed_paths，且 verifier 直接启动 frontend/server.mjs，无法由 scripts/local-runtime 内的合法修改修复

product_alignment.p0: 真实学习证据与教师干预闭环
product_alignment.contribution: 解除 canonical runtime 不可重复启动、运行态来源不清和前后端联调不稳定阻塞
non_goals: 不修改业务 API、前端页面或数据库 schema
不自动终止任何既有或未知进程
不把健康检查冒充浏览器黄金闭环验收

minimal_tests.name: canonical 运行态连续两次启动复用

test_evidence.name: PowerShell 语法解析
test_evidence.summary: 5 PowerShell scripts parsed and 3 Python helpers compiled.

test_evidence.name: attempt 3 隔离套件初次校准
test_evidence.summary: Exact argv validation correctly rejected the original generic positive fixture; fixture contract was restricted to temp yuzan-runtime-test directories and non-production dynamic ports.

test_evidence.name: canonical 运行态连续两次启动复用
test_evidence.summary: Exact-commit clean startup passed; two start-core reuse calls kept identical PIDs/commit; foreign partial occupancy failed closed without kill/port change; verifier-style PowerShell sleep spoof was rejected with COMMAND_ARGV_MISMATCH; wrong commit was rejected; all launched PIDs exited in finally.

test_evidence.name: review round 2 实时 argv 与伪造记录负向复验
test_evidence.summary: Clean exact-HEAD provenance and repeated reuse passed; PowerShell sleeper failed exact executable/argv validation; a python sleeper with forged manifest and attestation hashes still failed against the live wrapper/child argv; partial foreign occupancy and wrong candidate commit remained fail closed.

test_evidence.name: attempt 7 exact-candidate 重跑
test_evidence.summary: 2026-07-26T18:18Z 在 e2350f3cc336c212778232ed2753930e0e1b213d 上通过 5 个 PowerShell/3 个 Python 语法检查；隔离 managed-runtime clean startup、相同 PID/commit 两次 ReuseOnly、foreign partial fail closed、PowerShell substring spoof、伪造记录哈希的 same-executable live argv spoof 与 wrong candidate commit 均通过，finally 清理所有 fixture PID。

test_evidence.name: attempt 8 exact-candidate 重跑
test_evidence.summary: 2026-07-26T18:52Z 在 9bb02084b6d662e44e29cd5ff8c81504a1fa52c3 上通过 5 个 PowerShell/3 个 Python 语法检查；clean exact-commit attestation、相同 PID/commit 两次复用、foreign partial fail closed、PowerShell argv spoof、伪造记录哈希的 same-executable live argv spoof 与 wrong candidate commit 均通过，隔离端口为 56966/56967/56968，fixture 进程由 finally 清理。

test_evidence.name: attempt 9 exact-candidate 重跑
test_evidence.summary: 2026-07-26T19:20Z 在 956839d32450e371d666817bf30f801c89d36c28 上通过 5 个 PowerShell/3 个 Python 语法检查；clean exact-commit attestation、相同 PID/commit 两次复用、foreign partial fail closed、PowerShell argv spoof、伪造记录哈希的 same-executable live argv spoof 与 wrong candidate commit 均通过，隔离端口为 58559/58560/58561，fixture 进程由 finally 清理。

test_evidence.name: attempt 10 review round 3 scope diagnosis
test_evidence.command: rg -n "demo-token|11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111|Demo fallback" frontend/login frontend/server.mjs; rg -n "<script|app.js" frontend/login/index.html
test_evidence.summary: frontend/login/index.html loads frontend/login/app.js; its API/network error path installs demo-token-*, the fixed school ID, and yuzan-demo-session before role redirect. The verifier reproduction starts frontend/server.mjs directly. Both frontend paths are outside this lease's write_set/allowed_paths, so no truthful repair can be made under P0-RUNTIME-IDEMPOTENT-STARTUP.

rollback: 回退本任务提交；脚本不终止、不重启既有进程，runtime-local 诊断 JSON 可直接删除
